agm.agm_result:
Agenda #1: The meeting approved the 2025 Annual Report and audited Financial Statements by KAP Gideon Adi dan Rekan, granting full discharge to the Boards. The decision was made on June 9, 2026, with 100% approval from the present quorum.
Agenda #2: Shareholders approved the allocation of Rp97.13 billion in net profit, designating Rp16.8 billion for reserves and Rp17.36 billion as cash dividends at Rp2 per share. The remaining balance will be recorded as retained earnings.
Agenda #3: Authority was delegated to the Board of Commissioners to determine the salaries and allowances for the Board of Directors and Commissioners for the 2026 fiscal year. This follows recommendations from the Nomination and Remuneration Committee.
Agenda #4: The Board of Commissioners was authorized to appoint an OJK-registered Public Accounting Firm to audit the 2026 fiscal year. The Board of Directors was authorized to set the honorarium and terms for the appointment.
Agenda #5: Koay Teik Soon was appointed as a new Independent Commissioner, and the board composition was updated for a term ending in 2027. The Board of Directors was granted the power and authority to manage all actions regarding these changes.
Agenda #6: Shareholders approved amending Article 3 of the Articles of Association to comply with the 2025 Indonesian Standard Classification of Business Fields (KBLI). The Board of Directors was granted power of attorney to execute and implement these changes.
Agenda #7: The company presented a report regarding the realization of the use of proceeds from the Rights Issue (PMHMETD I). No formal decision was required or taken for this agenda item.

agm.agm_result: Agenda #1: Approval of increasing issued and paid-up capital through a capital increase without pre-emptive rights (PMTHMETD), as proposed by PT MULTI SARANA NASIONAL, up to 868,000,000 new shares, representing a maximum of 10% of the company's total issued and fully paid shares, subject to applicable capital market regulations, particularly POJK No.14/2019. The meeting also approved the resulting amendment to Article 4 paragraph (2) of the Articles of Association and granted the Board of Directors the necessary authority to implement the PMTHMETD.
